主要内容: Beko, the international home appliance brand of Arcelik, has extended and expanded its sponsorship agreement with FC Barcelona, becoming the club's new Main Global Partner. The partnership includes Gerard Piqué as the global ambassador for the 'Eat Like a Pro' initiative, which focuses on promoting healthy eating and tackling childhood obesity. The agreement was announced at a joint press conference at FC Barcelona's Camp Nou facilities, establishing Beko as a main partner and official Training Partner of the club. The partnership aims to leverage FC Barcelona's global fan base, which reaches approximately 300 million people, to enhance Beko's brand awareness. The collaboration also includes joint initiatives over the next three sportive seasons, reinforcing Beko's position as a leading home appliance brand in Europe and expanding its presence in key markets such as Asia Pacific, Middle East & Africa, and Eastern Europe. Beko is a leading brand in the European home appliances market, particularly in white goods, and holds a top position in several key markets including the UK, France, and Poland.
